title: Notification of a spend of an asset output for a plugin to fund
description: Liquid only. The **asset_sweep** notification is sent after a unilateral close of an asset channel, for every output of ours in the channel's asset that onchaind wants to spend: to_local after its delay, to_remote, HTLC outputs, penalties, and our own HTLC transactions.

An asset cannot pay a transaction fee, so the transaction pays none: it spends the asset output as input 0 and pays all of it out at output 0 (to our close script, or the HTLC transaction's output), and that input is signed SIGHASH_SINGLE|SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY. lightningd does not broadcast it. The asset channel plugin (contrib/assetchan) adds L-BTC inputs and outputs that pay the fee, broadcasts it, and raises the fee until the asset output is spent on chain.
The channel's asset (the asset id as printed by elements-cli).
The spend, with input 0 signed and paying no fee.
The first block it can be mined in (its timelocks).
The block it should be mined by.
